instruction: I want to know the version of the app Voice Memos installed on my mac. Help me navigate to the page that shows this.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get value of attribute "AXChildren" of window 1 of (first application process whose frontmost is true)' 2>/dev/null | grep "Voice Memos" | grep -q "Version" && echo "True" || echo "False"
